_help: Day 1, room 7: the front garden, 'You came' (summer 2001). The drawings for Papa Henri and the letterbox; Chloé's leash; Juliette's first bucket under the roses; the gate ends the first day. See docs/STORY.md.

locks._why: The summer she first came through the gate is painted on her old bucket: 2001.
hints: When did you first come through this gate?
The garden gate wants the summer you first came; your old bucket knows.

locks._why: The house number (12, painted on the letterbox) written twice: 1212.
hints: Where did the drawings for Papa Henri go every day?
The house number on the letterbox, and how you wrote it on every envelope.

locks._why: Chloé scratches at the gate: she won't go on the street side without her leash, which was in the letterbox.
hints: Chloé keeps scratching at the gate.
She wants her leash, and it was in the letterbox.
Select the leash, then tap Chloé.

locks._why: Something is buried under the roses; Chloé digs once she has her leash.
hints: Someone has dug in that flower bed before. Not by hand.
Chloé could dig under the roses.
Tap Chloé, then tap the soil under the roses.

locks._why: A memory rolled under the bench; only Chloé fits.
hints: Something small rolled out of sight near the bench.
Tap Chloé, then tap under the bench.

clues.text: The house number, painted on the letterbox long ago: 12.
Your old red beach bucket, full of shells and dried seaweed. Painted on the side in wobbly letters: JULIETTE · 5 ANS · ÉTÉ 2001.
